types.description: Releco C4-A40FX/24VDC bare 4-pole changeover relay, AgNi, polarized 24 VDC coil with LED and protection diodes

document.title: ComatReleco World of Relays
document.pages: 55 (C4-A4x selection, figures 1–4); 11 (C2–C9 FX circuit); physical PDF pages equal printed pages

modelingNotes: Exact source spelling C4-A40FX/24VDC is retained. Manufacturer page 55 specifies C4-A4xFX/DC...V, x=0 for AgNi, with 24 V selected: C4-A40FX/DC24V.

Bare relay only: fourteen Faston.110 pins. S4-J and S4-P sockets are separately listed accessories, excluded from this type. Physical pin keys are used; IEC function labels are documented in terminal descriptions and are not additional terminals.

Page 55 figure 1 proves pin-to-function mapping; figure 4 shows the pin-face arrangement. Figure 1 is a functional schematic without a viewing direction; no left/right installation orientation is assigned. The pin-face view is interpreted as looking toward the projecting pins, not through a socket.

FX contains an LED, series polarity-protection diode and freewheeling diode (page 11 C2–C9 FX diagram). Pin 13=A1 positive and pin 14=A2 negative. These internal components are abstracted by the coil function; the supported coil symbol does not depict their semiconductor topology.

Four changeover poles are represented as paired NC and NO functions sharing each physical common. Coil actuation applies to all eight contact functions; neither contact state nor coil/LED/diode conduction creates a fixed net link.

Coil pins 13 and 14 are required by library policy for an operational relay. Contact pins are application-dependent. No separate PE, shield, communication or accessory terminals belong to this bare relay.

Coil nominal 24 VDC; operating range 0.8–1.1 UN (19.2–26.4 V); DC power 1.4 W; 24 VDC coil table gives 414 ohm and 58 mA. Contact capabilities are conditional: 10 A at 250 V AC-1 or 30 V DC-1; 2500 VA AC; inrush 30 A for 20 ms; recommended minimum 10 mA at 5 V. Higher DC voltages and inductive loads require page 55 figure 3; no universal contact voltage/current scalar is assigned.

connectionCoverage.notes: All fourteen bare-relay Faston pins documented in page 55 figures 1 and 4 are inventoried. Socket clamps and mating contacts are separate accessories. Integrated FX circuitry uses only coil pins 13 and 14.
